sourceItems.title: Container freight rates soar on consumer goods boom, supply chain kinks
normalizedClaims: Global container shipping rates hit records as U.S./European restocking demand, container scarcity and pandemic-distorted freight flows tightened effective capacity; the Freightos Baltic global index was at a record and up about 30% since July 1.

sourceItems.title: Container shipping bottlenecks will support record freight rates into 2021
normalizedClaims: Container demand rose sharply and capacity bottlenecks were expected to keep freight rates at record highs into 2021; analysts described the higher-rate environment as potentially persistent for months.

sourceItems.title: Container freight rates: Fresh surge in prices propels key commodity markets to record highs
normalizedClaims: A fresh year-end freight-rate surge was rippling through metals, petrochemicals and agriculture; logistics bottlenecks were expected to remain elevated into Q1 2021.

sourceItems.title: 新能源汽车产业发展规划（2021—2035年）
normalizedClaims: China issued a 2021-2035 NEV development plan emphasizing electrification, technology, infrastructure and market-led industry development, with a 2025 target around 20% NEV share of new vehicle sales.
observedChanges: NEV long-term adoption path becomes clearer

sourceItems.title: Brief analysis of the economic operation of the auto industry in November 2020
normalizedClaims: November NEV production/sales were about 198k/200k, +75.1%/+104.9% YoY, setting a monthly record; cumulative sales growth turned positive. Total auto sales also rose 12.6% YoY.

sourceItems.title: Copper trading volumes rebound as speculators return
normalizedClaims: China's economic recovery and stimulus boosted copper demand; LME copper had risen more than 50% from March and recently hit a 28-month high.

sourceItems.title: 2020年11月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: November manufacturing PMI rose to 52.1, production to 54.7, new orders to 53.9 and new export orders to 51.5, showing broad domestic/export recovery; raw-material purchase prices rose sharply.

sourceItems.title: 2020年12月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: December manufacturing PMI remained strong at 51.9 with production 54.2 and new orders 53.6; raw-material purchase prices accelerated to 68.0, reinforcing the upstream/input-price cycle.

sourceItems.title: DRAM Market Bulletin — November 11, 2020
normalizedClaims: TrendForce described the overall DRAM market in November as still experiencing weakening demand with contract prices continuing to slide from October.

sourceItems.title: DRAM Market Bulletin — November 25, 2020
normalizedClaims: Server DRAM contract prices were still projected to register a small decline in November, showing that the memory cycle had not yet joined the broader manufacturing/commodity recovery.

eventClusters.statement: Container freight rates reached record levels in Q4 as restocking demand, equipment scarcity and pandemic-distorted logistics tightened effective capacity; specialist sources expected the bottleneck to persist into early 2021.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Spot-rate gains are real but peak-duration risk is high. Deep research must freeze the forward earnings/cash path and allow multiple acceptable carrier expressions rather than overfit one winner.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is the high-rate environment still under-reflected in listed carriers, and which 1-3 carriers are acceptable expressions without requiring exact peer-best ranking?

eventClusters.statement: China NEV demand accelerated sharply in Q4 while the State Council extended a long-term policy framework through 2035, creating both near-term volume acceleration and a clearer structural adoption path.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Strong policy and volume can already be capitalized in premium growth stocks. Company-level earnings conversion and full-path expectation room remain mandatory.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed NEV/battery companies have realized conversion and a still-improving multi-period earnings path?

eventClusters.statement: China's manufacturing/export recovery and stimulus-driven demand pushed copper and other raw materials sharply higher while December input-price indices accelerated.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Commodity prices had already rallied substantially from March. Deep research must distinguish durable volume/cost advantage from pure spot-price beta and should allow a set of acceptable resource expressions.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which metal producers have acceptable normalized earnings paths if spot prices cool, rather than only current commodity beta?

eventClusters.statement: Despite broad manufacturing recovery, DRAM demand and contract pricing remained weak in November, creating a negative divergence between memory and the broader industrial cycle.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Single specialist origin and negative industry direction; deep research should fail closed unless a listed company has differentiated exposure or an independent earnings engine.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should the Skill explicitly avoid memory names despite the broader manufacturing recovery?

eventClusters.statement: China manufacturing, new orders and export orders strengthened through November-December while raw-material input prices accelerated, providing a broad positive macro backdrop but not a narrow stock thesis.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Use as context for shipping/metals/NEV; do not select stocks from macro alone.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as timing and persistence context rather than a standalone stock thesis.
